# Mixed-batching speedups (generated by analysis/mixed_tables.py)

Speedup = baseline time / RankFuse time on the same batch (> 1: RankFuse faster). Kernel-only: CUDA-graph GPU time of the LoRA call. incl. prepare: each side also pays its per-step sort / prepare cost, amortized over the model's LoRA calls per step (0.5B: 168, 7B: 196); see analysis/mixed_tables.py.

## Single adapter

RankFuse = rf2_ranges. On sorted order: rows sorted by rank before timing (the scheduler reorders requests; its cost is in the incl. columns). On random order it is one rf1_fused launch. rf2_ranges+permute (random-order tables): the engine cannot reorder requests, so each LoRA call also gathers x into rank order and adds the delta back (GPU time, per call) around rf2_ranges' sorted kernel.

Noise (rf1_fused pass 1 vs pass 0, same workload): r_max 64: median 1.000, p10-p90 0.994-1.006, r_max 128: median 1.000, p10-p90 0.995-1.005, r_max 256: median 1.001, p10-p90 0.997-1.008
